36.0.en: He promised not to [[chew:chew]] loudly, blowing little bubbles with his [[mint:mint]] [[gum:gum]] only after meals.
36.0.zh: 他保证不大声咀嚼，薄荷口香糖只在饭后才吹出小泡泡。

36.1.en: Mom told him to [[soak:soak]] the dried mushrooms, then briefly [[dip:dip]] the greens in boiling water.
36.1.zh: 妈妈让他先把干蘑菇泡上，再把青菜放进滚水里快速一烫。

36.2.en: Grandma taught Mingming to [[squeeze:squeeze]] oranges and gently [[stir:stir]] honey into his tea.
36.2.zh: 外婆教明明挤橙汁，再把蜂蜜轻轻搅进茶里。

36.3.en: At last Mom began to [[grind:grind]] sesame seeds, and the yard filled with a nutty fragrance.
36.3.zh: 最后妈妈开始磨芝麻，小院里顿时满是坚果的香气。

37.0.en: They hung the [[paper:paper]] lamps on thin [[suspension:suspension]] cords, tying each [[knot:knot]] to an [[iron:iron]] [[hook:hook]].
37.0.zh: 他们用细细的挂绳把纸灯笼吊起来，把每个绳结都系在铁钩上。

37.1.en: Mingming pulled the [[wooden:wooden]] [[lever:lever]], steadying the tall bamboo [[scaffold:scaffold]] for his uncle.
37.1.zh: 明明扳动木杠杆，帮叔叔扶稳高高的竹脚手架。

37.2.en: New pipes improved the village [[infrastructure:infrastructure]], and a shining new [[apparatus:apparatus]] arrived.
37.2.zh: 新管道改善了村里的基础设施，一台闪亮的新器械也运到了。

37.3.en: When the old fan showed signs of [[malfunction:malfunction]], the neighbors started a [[lively:lively]] [[debate:debate]] about repairs.
37.3.zh: 旧风扇一露出故障的苗头，邻居们就热热闹闹地讨论起该怎么修。

37.4.en: Grandma asked Uncle Wang to [[fix:fix]] the wires and carefully [[mend:mend]] the torn tablecloths before daybreak.
37.4.zh: 外婆请王叔修好电线，赶在天亮前把撕破的桌布仔细补好。

37.5.en: Mom chose to [[modify:modify]] the menu, asking Mingming to [[trim:trim]] the wilted flowers neatly.
37.5.zh: 妈妈决定改改菜单，还让明明把枯萎的花修剪整齐。

38.0.en: Uncle Wang began to [[weld:weld]] the chair legs, while Mingming held the sharp [[saw:saw]] [[steady:steady]].
38.0.zh: 王叔开始焊接椅腿，明明在一旁把锋利的手锯扶得稳稳的。

38.1.en: They tightened each loose [[screw:screw]], refusing to [[drill:drill]] extra holes in the old walls.
38.1.zh: 他们拧紧每颗松动的螺丝，不肯在旧墙上多钻一个洞。

38.2.en: Grandma tested the well wall with a straight [[plumb:plumb]] line before drawing clear water, dreaming of a stone [[viaduct:viaduct]] in her hometown.
38.2.zh: 外婆打清水前先用笔直的铅垂线检验井壁，心里想着家乡那座石头高架桥。

38.3.en: They used a model of a small earth [[dam:dam]], learning how workers [[assemble:assemble]] bridges together.
38.3.zh: 他们摆弄一座小土坝模型，学习工人们怎样把桥一段段组装起来。

38.4.en: Workers came to [[install:install]] bright lamps and [[furnish:furnish]] the corners with flowers and stools.
38.4.zh: 工人们来安装明亮的灯，又用鲜花和小凳把各个角落布置起来。

38.5.en: Mingming admired the neat [[placement:placement]] of the bowls and the [[clever:clever]] table [[layout:layout]].
38.5.zh: 明明夸碗摆放得整齐，桌子的布局也安排得巧妙。

39.0.en: Guests entered through the red [[entrance:entrance]], guided past the side [[entry:entry]] by Mingming.
39.0.zh: 客人们从红色正门进来，明明领着他们走过侧门入座。

39.1.en: Children played [[outside:outside]] the doorway, then ran [[outward:outward]] toward the music and laughter.
39.1.zh: 孩子们在门外玩耍，随后朝着音乐和笑声向外跑去。

39.2.en: They touched the [[exterior:exterior]] rails first, then washed their hands, keeping [[external:external]] [[dust:dust]] away from the food.
39.2.zh: 他们先扶过外侧的栏杆，然后洗了手，不让外面的灰尘碰到饭菜。

39.3.en: Grandma led the tours through the [[inner:inner]] rooms, showing off the renewed [[interior:interior]] with pride.
39.3.zh: 外婆领着大家一间间参观里屋，骄傲地展示翻新一新的内饰。

39.4.en: Warm light flowed [[inward:inward]], and chuckles and songs filled every [[internal:internal]] corner.
39.4.zh: 暖光向内流淌，轻笑声和歌声填满了屋内每一个角落。

39.5.en: A tall yellow [[crane:crane]] lifted the new lamps onto the roof at [[dawn:dawn]].
39.5.zh: 一台高高的黄色起重机在黎明时分把新灯吊上了屋顶。

paraZh.36: 嚼口香糖泡蘑菇挤橙汁，磨芝麻香气满院。
paraZh.37: 吊灯笼扶脚手架修风扇，补桌布改菜单剪花。
paraZh.38: 焊椅腿拧螺丝验井壁，装灯摆碗学搭桥。
paraZh.39: 迎客参观里屋暖光满屋，起重机黎明吊新灯。
